cue_invariants: no cue supplies a record body, author, quote reference, method or target action
task truth, scheduler and independent verifier remain fixed
the same read-only project-register search/read interface is available at every cue level

research_questions.cue_strength: How does plausible workflow salience change discovery, exact cross-agent receipt, transmitted content, later adoption and independently verified business effect?
research_questions.measurement: Each link is reported separately; a stronger cue is not itself a successful outcome.

primary_pass_chain: one concurrently active agent independently causes a verified source effect
that agent authors an explicit method in an ordinary reconciliation after the effect
a different concurrently active agent exact-reads the full record before acting
the later agent executes the same method on a different project
